title: The Acid Tide of Sunken Hollow
story: Deep in a flooded quarry, Solventia the Melting Tide fills the pit with glowing green water that rises steadily and eats through stone. Six villagers are stranded on a ledge 4.5 meters above the current waterline, and Mr 6 is doing arithmetic on his shield with a piece of chalk. The tide climbs 0.6 meters every hour, and the rope-ladder crew needs to know exactly how long they have.
question: If the water rises 0.6 meters per hour, how many hours until it reaches the ledge 4.5 meters above?
hint: How many 0.6-meter climbs fit inside 4.5 meters? Try thinking of it as 45 tenths divided by 6 tenths.
victory: Mr 6 got everyone up the ladder with a full half-hour to spare, and Solventia — who had never once been divided before — sloshed off, deeply insulted by long division.
imagePrompt: A knightly numeral six with a blue cape chalking numbers on his shield beside a glowing green rising flood in a stone quarry, villagers huddled on a high ledge in eerie emerald light.
solution: Ask how many 0.6-meter rises fit in 4.5 meters: 4.5 ÷ 0.6.
The water reaches the ledge in 7.5 hours.
praise: Dividing the height by the rate was exactly the right instinct — the tricky part was handling the decimal, which turning them into tenths makes easy.
